pageCache.text:
BOYS BOARDING SCHOOL
Experience an immersive, vibrant educational community at Marathon Science School’s boarding program. Our unique “24-hour education” approach fosters a supportive environment grounded in affection and respect, providing students with a well-rounded, enriching experience that extends beyond the classroom.
A warm welcome to our secondary school’s website. As Headteacher, I am delighted you are exploring our community and learning about what makes our school unique.
Our focus is on holistic development, blending academic excellence with the social, emotional, and personal growth of each student. We provide a safe, inclusive, and nurturing environment where every child feels valued and supported.
We offer diverse academic subjects and extracurricular opportunities to help students discover and develop their passions, talents, and skills to their fullest potential.
Diversity and Global Awareness
Our diverse student body enriches our learning environment, celebrating unique cultural identities and preparing students for success in a globalized world.
Strong parent-school collaboration is at the heart of our approach. Open communication and partnership ensure the best outcomes for our students.
Explore our website for more information. Reach out to us with questions or to learn more about how we can support your child’s journey toward success and excellence.
EDUCATION AND TRAINING
With an educational philosophy that shapes the world, we cultivate generations who are morally and culturally enriched, proud to belong, and nurtured in an educational atmosphere characterized by unity of heart and harmony of spirit. Supported by a dedicated team of expert educators, we raise individuals who are holistically developed in both substance and spirit, contributing positively to themselves, their families, and all humanity, with strong and upright character.
~ Marathon Science School ~
A HOME FOR GROWTH AND LEARNING
Transformative approaches in education lead to tangible success. At Marathon Science School, we focus on fostering a well-rounded student development. This includes academic achievement, linguistic proficiency, social skills, mental and physical growth, emotional intelligence, and moral integrity. Our mission is to exceed expectations for what a school can achieve, providing much more than education—empowering students for life.
EXPERIENCES TO LAST A LIFETIME!
We offer a diverse range of clubs in sports, arts, academics, and social activities to help students build confidence, discover their interests, and develop teamwork and friendship. Join us for enriching experiences that make school life memorable!
I loved my experience at Marathon Science School. Looking back, I feel so grateful for the years I spent there and the incredible support I received from all the teachers. I highly recommend this school to people all around the world, especially because of its unique cultural boarding experience at the Suleymaniye campus in Hackney. The school provides a wonderful, culturally rich atmosphere where I was able to learn so much about my heritage and religion. Marathon Science School has given me lifelong values, and for that, I am truly thankful.
Admission Process in Stages
Step 1: Application Submission
Begin the process by completing the application form available on our website.
Step 2: Administrative Follow-Up
Once the form is submitted, our administrative team will contact the family to arrange:
• A school tour to explore our facilities.
• A test booking for the student.
Step 3: Reference Check
As part of the evaluation, the administration may request a reference from the student’s current school.
Step 4: Assessment and Boarding Evaluation
After successfully passing the test and reference review, boarding applicants may undergo:
• A boarding trial to ensure readiness and compatibility.
Step 5: Final Registration
The finance team will complete the registration process for successful applicants.
Places are offered on a first-come, first-served basis for each year group, so early applications are encouraged.
With 16 years of experience, we bring expertise, dedication, and a proven track record of success to everything we do.

IS THE BEST INVESTMENT
“An educational plane tree with roots extending deep into a rich past, branches firmly connected to a sturdy trunk, growing into the future with hope, love, and excitement.”
began its journey in private education by opening its first institution in Lewisham at 2009, driven by a sense of responsibility instilled by this service philosophy.
Marathon Science School opened in year 2009 situated in Lewisham, benefits from a vibrant and culturally rich environment that enhances its educational offerings. The school is surrounded by historical landmarks and natural beauty, including the iconic Greenwich Park, the Royal Observatory, and the Cutty Sark. The school has continued to expand its reach and impact, establishing itself as a leading institution that integrates a strong academic foundation with ethical and cultural education, rooted in Islamic values.
In line with its commitment to education, the school continues to offer high-quality education within an environment enriched with national and spiritual values. It prepares students for life in all aspects while expanding its reach globally at both national and international levels.
Our Mission and Vision at Marathon Science School
At Marathon Science School, we are deeply committed to fostering an environment that nurtures personal growth, academic achievement, and ethical values. Our mission is rooted in the holistic development of our students, preparing them to excel in all areas of life.
Our mission is to cultivate generations with strong character who are beneficial to themselves, their families, and all humanity. This is achieved within an educational environment where harmony of heart and spiritual unity prevails, guided by a dedicated team of educational experts. We aim to develop individuals who are balanced in both material and spiritual aspects.
• Build Confidence and Self-Esteem: Empower pupils to believe in themselves and their abilities.
• Encourage Resilience and Discipline: Instill self-motivation and a strong sense of determination.
• Develop Purpose and Awareness: Cultivate empathy and a sense of responsibility towards others.
• Stimulate Intellectual Curiosity: Foster independent thinking and a love for learning.
• Enhance Communication Skills: Equip pupils to express themselves clearly and effectively.
• Deepen Moral and Cultural Awareness: Strengthen students’ understanding of spiritual, moral, social, and cultural dimensions.
• Enrich Lives: Provide opportunities to discover new interests and talents.
• Inspire Ambition: Encourage students to aim high and realize their full potential.
• Promote Responsibility and Justice: Raise awareness of global heritage and social justice.
• Shape Future Leaders: Guide students to become compassionate, capable leaders of tomorrow.
Our vision is to become a respected educational institution, proud to be a part of, that upholds moral and cultural values while pioneering an educational approach that shapes the world.
Our mission is fulfilled through:
• A Caring Atmosphere: A safe, friendly, family-oriented environment that promotes well-being.
• Islamic Ethos: A nurturing environment fostering identity and spiritual growth.
• Innovative Education: A ‘24-hour education’ model enhanced by modern technologies and exceptional role models.
• Enriched Curriculum: A diverse and ambitious curriculum complemented by extracurricular activities.
• Healthy Living: Nutritious, halal, and wholesome meals to ensure physical and mental well-being.
At Marathon, we aim to achieve a legacy of confident, well-rounded individuals who are ready to make a positive impact on the world.
